──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n398\t// Command handlers\n399\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n400\t\n401\t/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n402\t///\n403\t/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers, even when invoked from\n404\t/// inside an existing tmux session. The only exception is a re-entrant inner\n405\t/// invocation launched by `launch_in_tmux()`, which is identified by the\n406\t/// `NEEDLE_INNER=1` environment variable and runs the worker resume: bool,\n414\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n415\t) -> Result<()> {\n416\t    // Determine workspace root (CLI arg → canonicalized, else global default).\n417\t    let workspace_root = if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n418\t        ws.canonicalize().unwrap_or_else(|_| ws.clone())\n419\t    } else {\n420\t        let global = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n421\t        global.workspace.default.clone()\n422\t    };\n423\t\n424\t    // Load full resolved config (global → workspace .needle.yaml → env → CLI).\n425\t    let cli_overrides = CliOverrides {\n426\t ConfigLoader::load_resolved(&workspace_root, cli_overrides)?;\n432\t\n433\t    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n434\t        config.agent.timeout = t;\n435\t    }\n436\t\n437\t    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n438\t        config.self_modification.hot_reload = hr;\n439\t    }\n440\t\n441\t    if resume {\n442\t        // Hot-reload resume: inherit worker identity from --identifier,\n443\t        // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n444\t        let worker_id = identifier\n445\t            .clone()\n446\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n447\t\n448\t        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n449\t        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, &worker_id)?;\n450\t\n451\t        // Emit upgrade.completed telemetry.\n452\t        let current_hash = crate::upgrade::file_hash(\n453\t            &std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?,\n454\t        )\n455\t        .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"unknown\".to_string());\n456\t\n457\t        match &resume_state {\n458\t            Some(state) => {\n459\t                tracing::info!(\n460\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n461\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n462\t                    beads_processed = state.beads_processed,\n463\t                    session = %state.session,\n464\t                    \"resuming worker after hot-reload\"\n465\t                );\n466\t            }\n467\t            None => {\n468\t                tracing::info!(\n469\t                    worker = %worker_id,\n470\t                    binary_hash = %&current_hash[..current_hash.len().min(12)],\n471\t crate::telemetry::Telemetry::from_config(worker_id.clone(), &config.telemetry)\n477\t            .unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n478\t                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"hook telemetry init failed, falling back\");\n479\t                crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(worker_id.clone())\n480\t            });\n481\t        tel.emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::UpgradeCompleted {\n482\t launched by launch_in_tmux() — run\n490\t        // the worker directly inside the dedicated session already created.\n491\t        let worker_id = identifier\n492\t            .clone()\n493\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n494\t        let agent_name = agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(&config.agent.default);\n495\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n496\t        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant invocation)\");\n497\t        run_worker(config, worker_id)\n498\t    } else {\n499\t        // Always create dedicated tmux sessions, even if already inside tmux.\n500\t        launch_workers(\n501\t            config, workspace, agent, count, identifier, timeout, hot_reload,\n502\t        )\n503\t    }\n504\t}\n505\t\n506\t/// Launch `count` workers in separate tmux sessions with staggered startup delays.\n507\tfn launch_workers(\n508\t    config: Config,\n509\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n510\t    agent: Option<String>,\n511\t    count: u32,\n512\t    identifier: Option<String>,\n513\t    timeout: Option<u64>,\n514\t    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n515\t) -> Result<()> {\n516\t    let agent_name = agent\n517\t        .as_deref()\n518\t        .unwrap_or(&config.agent.default)\n519\t        .to_string();\n520\t    let stagger_secs = config.worker.launch_stagger_seconds;\n521\t    let max_workers = config.worker.max_workers;\n522\t\n523\t    if count == 0 {\n524\t        bail!(\"--count must be at least 1\");\n525\t    }\n526\t    if count as usize > NATO_ALPHABET.len() {\n527\t        bail!(\n528\t            \"--count {} exceeds the maximum of {} (NATO alphabet size)\",\n529\t            count,\n530\t            NATO_ALPHABET.len()\n531\t        );\n532\t    }\n533\t\n534\t    // Enforce max_workers cap (0 means launching {max_workers} workers\"\n543\t        );\n544\t        max_workers\n545\t    } else {\n546\t        count\n547\t    };\n548\t\n549\t    // --identifier is only meaningful for a single worker.\n550\t    if effective_count > 1 && identifier.is_some() {\n551\t        bail!(\"--identifier cannot be combined with --count > 1; identifiers are auto-assigned from the NATO alphabet\");\n552\t    }\n553\t\n554\t    // Detect existing sessions to avoid name collisions.\n555\t    let occupied = occupied_worker_ids(&agent_name)?;\n556\t    if !occupied.is_empty() {\n557\t        tracing::info!(\n558\t            occupied = ?occupied,\n559\t            \"found existing worker sessions\"\n560\t        );\n561\t    }\n562\t\n563\t    // Reject --identifier collision early.\n564\t    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n565\t        if occupied.contains(id) {\n566\t            bail!(\n567\t                \"worker '{}' is already running in session 'needle-{}-{}'\",\n568\t                id,\n569\t                agent_name,\n570\t                id\n571\t            );\n572\t        }\n573\t    }\n574\t\n575\t    // Build the list of worker IDs, skipping occupied names.\n576\t    let worker_ids: Vec<String> = if effective_count == 1 {\n577\t        vec![identifier.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n578\t            // Pick the first available NATO name.\n579\t            NATO_ALPHABET\n580\t                .iter()\n581\t                .find(|name| !occupied.contains(**name))\n582\t                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n583\t NATO_ALPHABET {\n588\t            if ids.len() >= effective_count as usize {\n589\t                break;\n590\t            }\n591\t            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n592\t                tracing::warn!(\n593\t                    worker_id = %name,\n594\t                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n595\t                );\n596\t                continue;\n597\t            }\n598\t            ids.push(name.to_string());\n599\t        }\n600\t        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n601\t            bail!(\n602\t                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n603\t                effective_count,\n604\t                ids.len(),\n605\t                occupied.len()\n606\t            );\n607\t        }\n608\t        ids\n609\t    };\n610\t\n611\t    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n612\t        let session_name = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n613\t\n614\t        tracing::info!(\n615\t            worker_id = %worker_id,\n616\t            sequence = seq,\n617\t            total = effective_count,\n618\t            session = %session_name,\n619\t            \"launching worker\"\n620\t        );\n621\t\n622\t        // Stagger: sleep before launching subsequent workers.\n623\t        if seq > 0 && stagger_secs > 0 {\n624\t            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(stagger_secs));\n625\t        }\n626\t\n627\t        launch_in_tmux(\n628\t            &session_name,\n629\t            workspace.clone(),\n630\t            agent.clone(),\n631\t            Some(worker_id.clone()),\n632\t            timeout,\n633\t            hot_reload,\n634\t        )?;\n635\t\n636\t        println!(\n637\t            \"[{}/{}] Started worker '{}' in tmux session: {session_name}\",\n638\t            seq + 1,\n639\t            effective_count,\n640\t            worker_id\n641\t        );\n642\t    }\n643\t\n644\t    let sanitized_agent = sanitize_session_name(&agent_name);\n645\t    if effective_count > 1 {\n646\t        println!(\n647\t            \"\\nStarted {effective_count} workers (stagger: {stagger_secs}s between launches).\"\n648\t        );\n649\t        println!(\"Attach to a worker with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-<name>\");\n650\t    } else {\n651\t        let worker_id = &worker_ids[0];\n652\t        println!(\"Attach with: tmux attach -t needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n653\t    }\n654\t\n655\t    Ok(())\n656\t}\n657\t\n658\t/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n659\t///\n660\t/// This must be called before any tracing spans are created so that the OTLP\n661\t/// layer can export them to the configured collector.\n662\t///\n663\t/// Note: Shutdown is handled by the OtlpSink in the telemetry module, not here.\n664\t#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\n665\tfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n666\t    worker_id: String,\n667\t    session_id: String,\n668\t    config: &crate::config::Config,\n669\t) -> Result<()> {\n670\t    use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider;\n671\t    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n672\t\n673\t    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n674\t\n675\t    // Check if OTLP is enabled\n676\t    if !config.telemetry.otlp_sink.enabled {\n677\t        // No OTLP - just initialize with fmt layer\n678\t        let fmt_layer = .with(fmt_layer)\n683\t            .try_init()\n684\t            .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n685\t        return Ok(());\n686\t    }\n687\t\n688\t    // OTLP is enabled - attributes\n693\t    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n694\t        &worker_id,\n695\t        &session_id,\n696\t        otlp_config,\n697\t        Some(&config.agent.default),\n698\t        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n699\t        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n700\t    )\n701\t    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n702\t\n703\t    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n704\t    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n705\t        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n706\t    tokio::spawn(async move {\n707\t        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n708\t            tracing::warn!(\n709\t                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n710\t                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n711\t                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n712\t            );\n713\t        }\n714\t    });\n715\t\n716\t    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n717\t    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n718\t        \"grpc\" => {\n719\t            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n720\t        }\n721\t        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n722\t            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n723\t        }\n724\t        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n725\t    };\n726\t\n727\t    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n728\t    let otlp_layer = tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer_provider.tracer(\"needle\"));\n729\t\n730\t    // Create a fmt layer that works with any subscriber implementing LookupSpan\n731\t    // We build this after the OTLP layer to ensure proper type compatibility\n732\t    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(otlp_layer).with(\n733\t        tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n734\t            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n735\t            .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n736\t    );\n737\t\n738\t    subscriber\n739\t        .try_init()\n740\t        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber with OTLP\")?;\n741\t\n742\t    Ok(())\n743\t}\n744\t\n745\t/// No-op tracing initialization when OTLP feature is disabled.\n746\t#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\n747\tfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n748\t    _worker_id: String,\n749\t    _session_id: String,\n750\t    _config: &crate::config::Config,\n751\t) -> Result<()> {\n752\t    use Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\n784\tfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n785\t    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n786\t}\n787\t\n788\t/// Start the worker state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n789\t///\n790\t/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n791\t/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n792\t/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n793\t/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\n794\tfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n795\t    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n796\t    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n797\t\n798\t    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n799\t    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n800\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating tokio runtime...\");\n801\t    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n802\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tokio runtime created\");\n803\t\n804\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: initializing tracing subscriber...\");\n805\t    let session_id = generate_session_id_for_worker();\n806\t    init_tracing_subscriber(qualified_id.clone(), session_id.clone(), &config)?;\n807\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tracing subscriber initialized\");\n808\t\n809\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating telemetry...\");\n810\t    let telemetry =\n811\t        Telemetry::from_config(qualified_id.clone(), &config.telemetry).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n812\t            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to create hook-enabled telemetry, falling back\");\n813\t            Telemetry::new(qualified_id.clone())\n814\t        });\n815\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: telemetry // Fixes the silent pre-init deadlock where the JSONL file is created but empty.\n820\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: emitting worker.booting event (sync)...\");\n821\t    telemetry.emit_sync(EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n822\t        worker_name: worker_name.clone(),\n823\t        version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n824\t    })?;\n825\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: worker.booting written to disk\");\n826\t\n827\t    // Start the async writer thread after worker.booting is on disk.\n828\t    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // OTLP is enabled - create the OTLP layer inline\n    // We create it inline to avoid type erasure issues with boxed layers\n    let otlp_config = &config.telemetry.otlp_sink;\n\n    // Build resource attributes\n    let resource = crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_resource(\n        &worker_id,\n        &session_id,\n        otlp_config,\n        Some(&config.agent.default),\n        None, // model - not available in AgentConfig\n        config.workspace.default.to_str(),\n    )\n    .context(\"failed to build OTel resource\")?;\n\n    // Create drop channel for tracing layer\n    let (drop_tx, mut drop_rx) =\n        tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel::<crate::telemetry::otlp::DropEvent>();\n    tokio::spawn(async move {\n        while let Some(drop) = drop_rx.recv().await {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                signal = drop.signal.as_str(),\n                dropped_count = drop.dropped_count,\n                \"OTLP tracing layer export failure\"\n            );\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n        \"grpc\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_grpc_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        \"http\" | \"http/protobuf\" => {\n            crate::telemetry::otlp::OtlpSink::build_http_providers(otlp_config, &resource, drop_tx)?\n        }\n        other => anyhow::bail!(\"invalid OTLP protocol: {other}, must be 'grpc' or 'http'\"),\n    };\n\n    // Create the OpenTelemetry tracing layer\n    let otlp_layer = tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer_provider.tracer(\"needle\"));\n\n    // Create a fmt layer that works with any subscriber implementing LookupSpan\n    // We build this after the OTLP layer to ensure proper type compatibility\n    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(otlp_layer).with(\n        tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n            .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n            .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n    );\n\n    subscriber\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber with OTLP\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// No-op tracing initialization when OTLP feature is disabled.\n#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\nfn init_tracing_subscriber(\n    _worker_id: String,\n    _session_id: String,\n    _config: &crate::config::Config,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use tracing_subscriber::{layer::SubscriberExt, util::SubscriberInitExt};\n\n    let use_ansi = use_ansi();\n\n    // Initialize with just the stdout layer when OTLP is disabled\n    tracing_subscriber::registry()\n        .with(\n            tracing_subscriber::fmt::layer()\n                .with_writer(std::io::stderr)\n                .with_ansi(use_ansi),\n        )\n        .try_init()\n        .context(\"failed to initialize tracing subscriber\")?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Helper function to determine ANSI support (non-Android platforms).\n#[cfg(not(target_os = \"android\"))]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    atty::is(atty::Stream::Stderr)\n}\n\n/// Helper function for Android (no ANSI).\n#[cfg(target_os = \"android\")]\nfn use_ansi() -> bool {\n    false\n}\n\n/// Generate a session ID for a worker.\n///\n/// Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\nfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n}\n\n/// Start the worker state machine (called when inside tmux or for direct mode).\n///\n/// Creates telemetry and the tokio runtime *before* any other initialization\n/// so that `worker.booting` is the very first JSONL event. Each subsequent\n/// init step is wrapped with `init.step.started` / `init.step.completed` so a\n/// silent hang pinpoints the exact blocking call.\nfn run_worker(config: Config, worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n\n    // Phase 0: create tokio runtime + telemetry, emit worker.booting immediately.\n    // Emit eprintln diagnostics before each step so hangs are visible even if telemetry fails.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating tokio runtime...\");\n    let rt = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().context(\"failed to create tokio runtime\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tokio runtime created\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: initializing tracing subscriber...\");\n    let session_id = generate_session_id_for_worker();\n    init_tracing_subscriber(qualified_id.clone(), session_id.clone(), &config)?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: tracing subscriber initialized\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: creating telemetry...\");\n    let telemetry =\n        Telemetry::from_config(qualified_id.clone(), &config.telemetry).unwrap_or_else(|e| {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to create hook-enabled telemetry, falling back\");\n            Telemetry::new(qualified_id.clone())\n        });\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: telemetry created\");\n\n    // Emit worker.booting SYNCHRONOUSLY before starting the async writer.\n    // This guarantees the event is written to disk even if start_and_wait() hangs.\n    // Fixes the silent pre-init deadlock where the JSONL file is created but empty.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: emitting worker.booting event (sync)...\");\n    telemetry.emit_sync(EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n        worker_name: worker_name.clone(),\n        version: env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string(),\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: worker.booting written to disk\");\n\n    // Start the async writer thread after worker.booting is on disk.\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting telemetry writer thread...\");\n    rt.block_on(telemetry.start_and_wait())\n        .context(\"writer thread failed to start\")?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: writer thread started\");\n\n    // Phase 1: bead store discovery.\n    // Use BfCliBeadStore for atomic server-selected bead claiming.\n    let store: Arc<dyn crate::bead_store::BeadStore> =\n        Arc::new(init_step(\"bead_store_discover\", &telemetry, || {\n            crate::bead_store::BfCliBeadStore::discover(\n                config.workspace.default.clone(),\n                None,                       // model: do not filter by model — beads are untagged\n                Some(\"needle\".to_string()), // harness\n                Some(env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string()), // harness_version\n            )\n            .context(\"failed to locate bf CLI for bead store\")\n        })?);\n\n    // Phase 2: worker construction (heavy — prompt loading, adapter discovery, etc.).\n    let mut worker = init_step(\"worker_construction\", &telemetry, || {\n        Ok(Worker::new_with_telemetry(\n            config,\n            worker_name.clone(),\n            store,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        ))\n    })?;\n\n    // Boot timeout guard: self-abort if init took >60 s.\n    let elapsed_ms = boot_start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    if elapsed_ms > 60_000 {\n        telemetry.emit(EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms })?;\n        bail!(\"boot exceeded 60 s ({elapsed_ms} ms), aborting\");\n    }\n\n    eprintln!(\n        \"NEEDLE worker boot: all init steps completed in {elapsed_ms}ms, starting worker loop...\"\n    );\n    let result = rt.block_on(worker.run())?;\n\n    tracing::info!(final_state = %result, \"worker finished\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n///\n/// Each step's completion is force-flushed to disk so that if a subsequent\n/// step blocks indefinitely, the telemetry log shows exactly where it stopped.\n/// Also emits eprintln diagnostics for visibility even if telemetry hangs.\nfn init_step<T, F>(name: &str, tel: &Telemetry, f: F) -> Result<T>\nwhere\n    F: FnOnce() -> Result<T>,\n{\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: starting init step '{name}'...\");\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepStarted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n    })?;\n    let t = Instant::now();\n    let result = f();\n    let elapsed = t.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n    tel.emit(EventKind::InitStepCompleted {\n        step: name.to_string(),\n        duration_ms: elapsed,\n    })?;\n    eprintln!(\"NEEDLE worker boot: init step '{name}' completed in {elapsed}ms\");\n    // Force-flush so the step completion is visible before the next (potentially blocking) step.\n    tel.force_flush(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1))?;\n    result\n}\n\n/// Returns true when this process is a re-entrant inner invocation launched\n/// by `launch_in_tmux()`, indicated by `NEEDLE_INNER=1` in the environment.\nfn is_needle_inner() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"NEEDLE_INNER\").is_ok_and(|v| v == \"1\")\n}\n\n/// Create a single tmux session and re-exec self inside it with `--count 1`.\nfn launch_in_tmux(\n    session_name: &str,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    timeout: Option<u64>,\n    hot_reload: Option<bool>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Build the command that tmux will run inside the session.\n    let self_exe = std::env::current_exe().context(\"failed to locate own binary\")?;\n    let mut inner_args = vec![\"run\".to_string()];\n\n    if let Some(ref ws) = workspace {\n        inner_args.push(\"--workspace\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(ws.display().to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(ref a) = agent {\n        inner_args.push(\"--agent\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(a.clone());\n    }\n    // Each session runs exactly one worker; identifier is always resolved before call.\n    inner_args.push(\"--count\".to_string());\n    inner_args.push(\"1\".to_string());\n    if let Some(ref id) = identifier {\n        inner_args.push(\"--identifier\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(id.clone());\n    }\n    if let Some(t) = timeout {\n        inner_args.push(\"--timeout\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(t.to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(hr) = hot_reload {\n        inner_args.push(\"--hot-reload\".to_string());\n        inner_args.push(hr.to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Build stderr log path: ~/.needle/logs/<session_name>.stderr.log\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \".\".to_string());\n    let stderr_log = format!(\"{home}/.needle/logs/{session_name}.stderr.log\");\n\n    let inner_cmd = format!(\n        \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 {} {} 2>> {}\",\n        shell_escape(&self_exe.display().to_string()),\n        inner_args\n            .iter()\n            .map(|a| shell_escape(a))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \"),\n        shell_escape(&stderr_log)\n    );\n\n    let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\"new-session\", \"-d\", \"-s\", session_name, &inner_cmd])\n        .status()\n        .context(\"failed to launch tmux — is tmux installed?\")?;\n\n    if !status.success() {\n        bail!(\n            \"tmux new-session exited with status {} for session '{}'\",\n            status,\n            session_name\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle stop` — send SIGTERM to worker processes in tmux sessions.\nfn cmd_stop(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    if !all && identifier.is_none() {\n        bail!(\"specify --all or --identifier <NAME>\");\n    }\n\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    for session in &targets {\n        tracing::info!(session = %session, \"sending SIGTERM to tmux session\");\n        // tmux send-keys sends C-c to the foreground process\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"send-keys\", \"-t\", session, \"C-c\", \"\"])\n            .status()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to send SIGTERM to session '{session}'\"))?;\n\n        if status.success() {\n            // Wait up to 5 seconds for the worker to exit gracefully\n            for _ in 0..50 {\n                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));\n                let session_exists = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                    .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                    .output()\n                    .map(|o| o.status.success())\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                if !session_exists {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            // Kill the session to clean up (worker may have already exited)\n            let kill_status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n                .status();\n            match kill_status {\n                Ok(s) if s.success() => println!(\"Stopped: {session}\"),\n                Ok(_) => println!(\"Stopped: {session} (session already gone)\"),\n                Err(e) => println!(\"Warning: stopped {session} but failed to kill session: {e}\"),\n            }\n        } else {\n            println!(\"Warning: could not stop session '{session}' (status: {status})\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle cleanup` — remove orphaned tmux sessions.\n///\n/// Finds and removes needle tmux sessions that no longer have active workers.\n/// With --all, removes all needle sessions regardless of worker status.\nfn cmd_cleanup(all: bool, identifier: Option<String>) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No needle sessions running.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let targets: Vec<&str> = if all {\n        sessions.iter().map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect()\n    } else {\n        let id = identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\");\n        sessions\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|s| id.is_empty() || s.name.contains(id))\n            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())\n            .collect()\n    };\n\n    if targets.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching sessions found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let mut cleaned = 0;\n    for session in &targets {\n        // Kill the session\n        let status = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n            .args([\"kill-session\", \"-t\", session])\n            .status();\n\n        match status {\n            Ok(s) if s.success() => {\n                println!(\"Cleaned up: {session}\");\n                cleaned += 1;\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: session '{session}' already gone\");\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                println!(\"Warning: failed to cleanup session '{session}': {e}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if cleaned == 0 {\n        println!(\"No sessions cleaned up.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"Cleaned up {cleaned} session(s).\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle list` — show running needle sessions.\nfn cmd_list(format: ListFormat) -> Result<()> {\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n\n    if sessions.is_empty() {\n        match format {\n            ListFormat::Table => println!(\"No needle sessions running.\"),\n            ListFormat::Json => println!(\"[]\"),\n        }\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", \"SESSION\", \"CREATED\", \"STATUS\");\n            println!(\"{}\", \"-\".repeat(70));\n            for s in &sessions {\n                println!(\"{:<40} {:<20} {:<10}\", s.name, s.created, s.status);\n            }\n        }\n        ListFormat::Json => {\n Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle init` — initialize v2 config with optional v1 migration.\n///\n/// Creates ~/.config/needle/config.yaml. stats` — show outcome statistics from telemetry logs.\nfn cmd_stats(\n    by: StatsBy,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    format: ListFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use crate::stats::{compute_stats, StatsDimension};\n\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let log_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"logs\");\n\n    let since_dt = since.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_since).transpose()?;\n    let until_dt = until.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_until).transpose()?;\n    let events = telemetry::read_logs(&log_dir, since_dt, until_dt, None)?;\n\n    let dimension = match by {\n        StatsBy::TemplateVersion => StatsDimension::TemplateVersion,\n        StatsBy::TaskType => StatsDimension::TaskType,\n        StatsBy::Worker => StatsDimension::Worker,\n    };\n\n    let mut rows = compute_stats(&events, dimension);\n    // Sort by beads descending so most active groups appear first.\n    rows.sort_by(|a, b| b.beads.cmp(&a.beads).then(a.key.cmp(&b.key)));\n\n    let dim_label = match by {\n        StatsBy::TemplateVersion => \"TEMPLATE VERSION\",\n        StatsBy::TaskType => \"TASK TYPE\",\n        StatsBy::Worker => \"WORKER\",\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        ListFormat::Table => {\n            if rows.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"No telemetry data found.\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n            let key_width = rows.iter().map(|r| r.key.len()).max().unwrap_or(16).max(16);\n            println!(\n                \"{:<width$} {:>6} {:>6} {:>6} {:>8} {:>9} {:>10} {:>12}\",\n                dim_label,\n                \"BEADS\",\n                \"PASS\",\n                \"FAIL\",\n                \"TIMEOUT\",\n                \"PASS RATE\",\n                \"AVG TOK\",\n                \"AVG COST\",\n                width = key_width,\n            );\n            println!(\n                \"{}\",\n                \"-\".repeat(key_width + 6 + 6 + 6 + 8 + 9 + 10 + 12 + 7)\n            );\n            for row in &rows {\n                let pass_rate = row\n                    .pass_rate()\n                    .map(|r| format!(\"{:.1}%\", r * 100.0))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| \"-\".to_string());\n                let avg_tok = row\n                    .avg_tokens()\n                    .map(|t| format!(\"{:.0}\", t))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| \"-\".to_string());\n                let avg_cost = row\n                    .avg_cost_usd()\n                    .map(|c| format!(\"${:.5}\", c))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|| \"-\".to_string());\n                println!(\n                    \"{:<width$} {:>6} {:>6} {:>6} {:>8} {:>9} {:>10} {:>12}\",\n                    row.key,\n                    row.beads,\n                    row.pass,\n                    row.fail,\n                    row.timeout,\n                    pass_rate,\n                    avg_tok,\n                    avg_cost,\n                    width = key_width,\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        ListFormat::Json => {\n            let json_rows: Vec<serde_json::Value> = rows\n                .iter()\n                .map(|row| {\n                    serde_json::json!({\n                        \"key\": row.key,\n                        \"beads\": row.beads,\n                        \"pass\": row.pass,\n                        \"fail\": row.fail,\n                        \"timeout\": row.timeout,\n                        \"pass_rate\": row.pass_rate(),\n Ok(())\n}\n\n/// `needle config` — view or inspect configuration.\nfn cmd_config(get: Option<String>, dump: bool, show_source: bool) -> Result<()> {\n    if show_source && !dump {\n
